item.title: 4.4 Magnitude Earthquake Hits Southern Iran Amid Intensifying Israeli And US Strikes
item.description: Southern Iran experiences a 4.4 magnitude quake as Israel and US intensify military strikes, with minor damages reported but no casualties so far.

item.title: Rivers Assembly To Screen Nine Commissioner Nominees
item.description: Rivers Assembly asks nominees to submit credentials and CVs ahead of screening for appointments into the state executive council.

item.title: Medical Council Suspends Euracare Director, Two Doctors From Practice Over Death of Adichie’s Son
item.description: Medical council suspends three doctors over alleged negligence in Chimamanda Adichie’s son’s death, orders disciplinary tribunal hearing.

item.title: Wale Edun: Implementation Of New Tax Laws Will Be Monitored To Ensure Fairness, Equity
item.description: Wale Edun assures that the implementation of the new tax laws will be monitored to ensure transparency, fairness and equity.

item.title: US Urges Citizens To Leave Middle Eastern Countries As Iran Conflict Widens
item.description: The US has urged its citizens to leave Middle Eastern countries as the conflict with Iran continues.

item.title: Anthony Ubani Slams Politicians, Says Leadership Means Serving the People, Not Enriching Pockets
item.description: Executive Director of Fix Politics Initiative, Anthony Ubani, criticises Nigeria’s political class, insisting that leadership is about service, not self-enrichment.

item.title: National Assembly Moves To Domesticate AfCFTA Agreement
item.description: The National Assembly has pledged legislative action to domesticate the AfCFTA Agreement for Nigeria’s economic gains.

item.title: Tinubu Orders Release Of Funds For Space Assets Maintenance
item.description: President Tinubu directs immediate funding for Nigeria’s space assets, stressing accountability and national value in implementing revised 25-year programme.

item.title: UK Envoy: Communities Safer When Women Participate In Peace Processes
item.description: The UK Deputy High Commissioner to Nigeria has said communities are safer when women participate in peacebuilding.

item.title: Tinubu Launches Renewed Hope Climate Change Awareness Tour
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has launched the Renewed Hope Climate Change Awareness Tour to promote climate resilience nationwide.
